models_used.principle: The artifact must explicitly list all three mandated families.

test_commands.principle: Commands document model resolution, extraction, alignment, parity, and schema checks.

test_exit_codes.principle: Exit codes prevent partial extraction becoming readiness.

token_and_truncation_parity.principle: Length or truncation cannot encode the target.

upstream_fixture_hashes.principle: Hashes bind embeddings to the clean exact causal corpus.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: True records exact labels; embeddings are not release authority.
